responsibility: This Texinfo file documents the PIM/Logitech-compatible variant of GNU Modula-2’s `SYSTEM` definition module, providing the nonportable machine interface expected when compiling in PIM mode. Compared with the ISO variant, it defines the PIM-style storage constants (`BITSPERBYTE`, `BYTESPERWORD`), target-related base types and sizing operations such as `ADR`, optional `SIZE`, `TSIZE`, `SHIFT`, `ROTATE`, `THROW`, and `TBITSIZE`, and also records the GM2 runtime entry points (`ShiftVal`, `ShiftLeft/Right`, `RotateVal`, `RotateLeft/Right`) that implement set shifts and rotates for non-word-sized sets, which the compiler maps from the language-level `SHIFT` and `ROTATE` operations.
